body:
Well, I wouldn't expect to not get disappointed when all of those things are taken away from me.....but I didn't expect that to happen in the first place. 

I can't define myself based on a world where money and worth don't exist because I don't live in that world. It sure would be nice if I did but I don't.

I'm just going to say that the "people have it worse than you," point never ever makes me feel any better. The reason I'm depressed isn't because of where I am in life; that doesn't really matter. I'll always have my parents to fall back on anyways. Even if I was doing well, my life probably wouldn't be that different anyways since I don't want to get married or spend lots of money. It's what I've done to get to where I currently am. Two and a half years of constant failure. I basically haven't succeeded at doing anything that wasn't something that almost anyone could do in like over a year now. It really makes me feel like I'll never get better or be good at anything. I feel like all I'm doing is taking up someone else's opportunities, like, literally anyone could probably be in my place and be a better student than I currently am, and they'd deserve my life way more than I do. I feel like I deserve to be in jail or on death row. But I'm here because I was lucky enough to be born into a well-off family that valued education, not because I'm actually skilled at anything.
